text:
Priya V: Heads-up — last-minute panel change for the senior infra candidate (Taylor R). Interview still Wed 1:00pm PT (60m). Our scheduled scribe (Samir) may be pulled to an incident. Need: 1) someone to scribe + submit debrief, 2) one extra interviewer if Samir is gone. Candidate packet + rubric: https://redwood.app/interviews/taylor-r • Prefer scribe who can capture scores in the template and hit the behavior anchors.

Samir P: I might get paged — willing to start as planned but can't guarantee debrief. If I'm pulled, can someone else take scribe? I can share a dummy notes snippet quickly.

Maya K: I can be scribe if Samir gets pulled. Happy to run the rubric normalization briefly after the call. :+1:

Elena: Can't cover, oncall that window. Sorry. If Maya is in, I suggest Aisha act as interviewer backup (she knows the infra PR).

Aisha: I can be backup interviewer for the first 30m and do quick follow-up questions. I can also take scribe if needed, but prefer Maya to do scoring so we avoid split responsibilities. Quick note: please enable AV recording + ASR so we can cross-check notes.

Priya V: Thanks all. Two asks before we lock: (1) who will be primary scribe? (2) Does anyone need the candidate's PR diff or test infra link? I'll attach both now.

Priya V: Attachments: PR diff: https://git.redwood/example/pull/482 • Test infra run: https://ci.redwood/job/infra-tests/482

Maya K: I'll be primary scribe. Will use the team note template and submit debrief within 2 hours. Can someone grant me edit access to the shared docs?

Priya V: Granting access now. Also tagging the recording/consent checklist — candidate gave verbal consent in pre-call. People Ops, please ensure recording is enabled and transcript saved to /interviews/records.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: post-interview debrief form -> https://redwood.app/debriefs/submit (please complete within 24h). Recording & ASR will be stored at https://redwood.app/interviews/records/taylor-r-7240009876 (access: interviewers + people-ops).

Aisha: Quick rubric question — for system design, do we weight scalability 35% and reliability 25% (rest behavior/communication), or do we use the updated weights from last week (scalability 30, reliability 30)?

Maya K: Use the updated weights (scalability 30, reliability 30). I'll call out the anchors in the notes.

Priya V: Final: Maya = scribe, Aisha = backup interviewer, Samir = maybe. Access granted, recording + ASR confirmed. Thanks everyone — I’ll send the calendar update (short buffer added: +10m after). :calendar:

Samir P: Thanks — if I'm freed from incident, I'll still join. If not, good handoff. Good luck team. :thumbsup:
